home.title: Put idle devices to work
home.subtitle: Turn phones and small computers into inference nodes, group them into pools and serve models through one API.

pools.title: Pools
pools.body: Group devices per organisation and serve a set of models from each pool.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.body: Enroll a device with a short code. It connects out to the gateway, no inbound access needed.

api.title: OpenAI-compatible API
api.body: Change only the base URL and API key in your existing client.

about.title: About SplitCortex
about.p1: SplitCortex is a platform for reusing mobile compute devices as inference serving nodes.
about.p2: Devices keep a secure outbound connection to the gateway, which authenticates requests, applies limits, balances load across healthy nodes and meters usage.
about.p3: Models are replicated onto every node of a pool, and each API key is bound to exactly one pool.
